<script type="text/javascript">
            (function () {
                'use strict';
                function expand(event) {
                    if (event.target.getAttribute('data-rv16exp')) return event.target.classList.add('-expand');
                    var targetName = event.target.getAttribute('data-rv16expand');
                    if (!targetName) return;
                    var targetElement = document.querySelector('[data-rv16exp="' + targetName + '"]');
                    if (!targetElement) return;
                    targetElement.classList.add('-expand');

                }
                function collapse(event) {
                    if (event.target.getAttribute('data-rv16exp')) return event.target.classList.remove('-expand');
                    var targetName = event.target.getAttribute('data-rv16collapse');
                    if (!targetName) return;
                    var targetElement = document.querySelector('[data-rv16exp="' + targetName + '"]');
                    if (!targetElement) return;
                    targetElement.classList.remove('-expand');
                }
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                    var footer = document.getElementById('rv16-footer');
                    var hovers = footer.querySelectorAll('[data-rv16exp]');

                    for (var i = 0; i < hovers.length; i++) {
                        hovers[i].addEventListener('mouseleave', collapse);
                        var open = hovers[i].parentNode.querySelector('[data-rv16expand]');
                        var close = hovers[i].querySelector('[data-rv16collapse]');
                        open.addEventListener('mouseenter', expand);
                        close.addEventListener('click', collapse);
                    }

                });
            })()
        </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
        var carousel;
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            if (document.getElementById('home-carousel')) {
                carousel = new XCarousel('home-carousel');
                carousel.videoControl = new CarouselVideoControl('home-carousel');

                if (window.innerWidth < 1200) {
                    var imgs = carousel.container.querySelectorAll('img[data-alt-size]');
                    for (var i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
                        if (imgs[i].getAttribute('data-alt-size') != '') {
                            imgs[i].setAttribute('data-default-size', imgs[i].src);
                            imgs[i].src = imgs[i].getAttribute('data-alt-size');
                            imgs[i].classList.add('-img-alt-size');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            var storeGallery = document.getElementById('storeGallery');
            if (storeGallery) {
                var url = '/rinascente/it/flagship-store/11115/roma-via-del-tritone/';
                var images = storeGallery.querySelector('ul');
                images.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                if (images) images.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    window.location.href = url;
                });
            }

            var lang = 'it';

            var d = new ScrollDirectionDetector(function (position, direction) {
                var current = position;
                var direction = direction;

                $('.-scroll-sensitive').each(function () {
                    var $this = $(this);
                    getElementScrollStatus(this, position, direction);
                })
            });

            var spinnerPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.rina-number-spinner');

            if (spinnerPanels.length > 0) {
                window.spinners = [];

                Array.prototype.forEach.apply(spinnerPanels, [function (el) {
                    el.classList.add('-loading');
                    window.spinners.push(new NumberSpinner(el));
                }])
            }

            window.addEventListener('load', function () {
                if (window.spinners) {
                    Array.prototype.forEach.apply(window.spinners, [function (comp) {
                        var top = comp.container.getBoundingClientRect().top;
                        var height = comp.container.clientHeight;
                        if (top + height * .25 < window.innerHeight) {
                            comp.start();
                        }
                    }]);
                }
            })

            var popup = new PromoModal(null, {
                event: 'DOMContentLoaded',
                name: 'black-friday-promo-2019',
                dismiss: lang === 'it' ? 'Chiudi' : 'Close',
                img: lang === 'it' ? 'https://www.rinascente.it/upl/ckuploads/images/bf_ita_19.jpg' : 'https://www.rinascente.it/upl/ckuploads/images/bf_eng.jpg',
                href: lang === 'it' ? 'https://www.rinascente.it/rinascente/promo/black-friday-2019/it.html' : 'https://www.rinascente.it/rinascente/promo/black-friday-2019/en.html',
                target: '?_blank',
                ga: true,
                start: new Date(2019, 4, 27),
                expire: new Date(2019, 5, 1, 1, 0, 0),
                persist: false,
                cookie: true
            })

            popup.create();

        });
    </script>
